---
title: "Manager manual"
number-sections: false

This manual covers Admin, the part of the shop's app that only managers can
open: verifying paperwork, second looks at hand checks, reviewing
changes, and keeping the staff list. It is written for every manager.

Managers use the same everyday screens as groomers. The [Groomer
manual](../groomer/index.qmd) applies to managers as well.

Each procedure is numbered and follows the same order: Purpose, Applies to,
Before you begin, Procedure, Result, and If something goes wrong. Carry out
the steps in order.

::: {.callout-note}
## Click or tap
This manual says **click**. On a tablet, tap wherever it says click.
:::
